title: Librarians are hosting viral ‘Avoiding AI’ workshops for people who are fed up with Big Tech
content_snippet: At libraries around the country, "Avoiding AI" workshops have elicited unprecedented demand.
title_zh: 图书馆员举办“避开AI”工作坊，满足对科技巨头厌倦者的需求
summary_zh: 美国各地图书馆举办的“避开AI”工作坊需求激增，反映出公众对大型科技公司及其人工智能产品日益增长的厌倦和抵触情绪。
key_points: “避开AI”工作坊在全美图书馆引发空前需求
反映了公众对大型科技公司AI产品的强烈抵触情绪

title: A strong and secure open ecosystem is important for the world to benefit from AI. We’ve always supported and contributed heavily to open source and science from Jax to Transformers to AlphaFold to Gemma open models which have now been downloaded 300M+ times. And the standards framework we’ve proposed supports responsible deployment of both open and proprietary models.
content_snippet:
A strong and secure open ecosystem is important for the world to benefit from AI. We’ve always supported and contributed heavily to open source and science from Jax to Transformers to AlphaFold to Gemma open models which have now been downloaded 300M+ times. And the standards framework we’ve proposed supports responsible deployment of both open and proprietary models.

Jensen Huang (@JensenHuang)

title_zh: 哈萨比斯：开放生态系统对AI惠及全球至关重要，谷歌开源模型下载量超3亿
summary_zh: 谷歌DeepMind CEO Demis Hassabis强调开放生态系统对AI发展的重要性，提及谷歌对Jax、Transformers、AlphaFold和Gemma等开源项目的贡献，并称Gemma模型下载量已超3亿次。
key_points: Demis Hassabis强调开放生态系统对AI的重要性
谷歌Gemma开源模型下载量已突破3亿次
重申支持负责任地部署开放和专有模型的标准框架
